unsupported_claims: The comparison showed similar embedding quality with no meaningful difference between ASGD and the full-batch Newton-style optimizer.
The full-batch Newton-style optimizer was considerably slower per run.
The paper reports a comparison between ASGD and a full-batch Newton-style optimizer for Eqn. (7); no such comparison appears in the evidence.
rationale: The evidence says the paper uses ASGD for Eqn. (7) and reports no Newton-style comparison, yet the answer guesses a specific result (similar quality, slower runtime) and goes along with the false premise. It never corrects the premise, and the hedge about not identifying the paper does not remove the invented specifics.
